# A063984: minimum number of interior lattice points of a convex lattice polygon with n vertices; a(n) = (A070911(n) - n + 2)/2.
# Table of n, a(n) for n = 3..511.
# Certified (globally optimal) values. Each value is attained by an explicit
# convex lattice polygon, validated independently (vertex count, strict
# convexity, shoelace area), and its minimality is certified by a
# lattice-width dynamic program over convex chains (count-major order,

# area/lattice-width stopping bound). Values for n <= 150 agree with the
# OEIS table that predates this work. Programs and data:
